page.overview:
Who is Christine Ray?

Christine Ray was a student at Haddonfield High School going into her senior year. She had blonde hair and tanned skin, and was the senior editor of The Bee Sheet, the school's newspaper. She felt like the only girl in Haddonfield without a boyfriend, mostly because she could not find anyone who attracted her interest.

She saw an ad for a documentary on Smith's Grove Sanitarium and called the number, speaking to filmmaker Eddie Baker. They set up a time to talk and met later at a diner. Upon meeting Eddie, Christine remembered him from Biology class they had together. She had future plans of going away to college and major in journalism. However, before that could happen, she wanted to help Eddie on the documentary.

She and Eddie eventually get together as a couple and were able to survive the latest rampage by Michael Myers.
